title: Parkio Daily for October 25, 2026
teaser: Four Magic Kingdom restaurants debut new menus; Port Orleans Riverside partially closes for work; wait times fell across all parks this week.

rides.name: Soarin'
rides.note: Lower waits during Festival of the Holidays dinner hour

bignews.title: Four Magic Kingdom restaurants roll out reimagined menus
bignews.body: Multiple counter and table service locations across the park are introducing new and updated dishes in an effort to strengthen the food lineup. The changes hit both quick-service and sit-down spots.

parkioInsight.text: Worth testing the new offerings during off-peak meal windows. Quick-service spots tend to see lighter crowds between 2–4pm when revised menus may still have full availability.

bignews.title: Port Orleans Riverside begins partial closure for construction
bignews.body: Work has started at the 34-year-old resort, with sections now off-limits to guests. Three general construction permits have been filed for Old Port Royale, the resort's central hub.

parkioInsight.text: Construction noise and restricted access may affect the resort experience. Guests staying here should plan for possible detours and earlier wake-ups if work starts mid-morning.

bignews.title: Wait times dropped across Disney World parks this week
bignews.body: Most attractions saw lower standby waits compared to recent days, reflecting lighter-than-usual mid-October crowds. The trend held across all four parks.

parkioInsight.text: Shorter waits tend to carry into the weekend before crowd levels reset. Hitting headliners mid-morning today may yield 15–25 minute windows on rides that often push 60+.

bignews.title: Jordan Fisher completes 2026 Candlelight Processional narrator lineup
bignews.body: The final open slot for EPCOT's holiday storytelling event now has a name. Fisher joins the previously announced roster for performances during Festival of the Holidays.

parkioInsight.text: Dining packages for Candlelight Processional tend to sell out quickly once all narrators are announced. Booking soon—especially for popular names—usually improves seating options.

topstories.title: Indiana Jones Adventure reopens at Disneyland with noticeable changes
topstories.body: The Adventureland dark ride returned to operation this week after a closure. Guests report updated effects and other modifications inside the Temple of the Forbidden Eye.

parkioInsight.text: Reopening windows often draw curious crowds but also showcase fresher show elements. Riding during early-morning or late-evening hours may offer shorter waits and a cleaner look at the updates.

topstories.title: Peter Pan attraction closure announced less than three years after opening
topstories.body: A newer Peter Pan-themed experience at a Disney park will temporarily shut down for maintenance work. The closure date and duration have been confirmed.

parkioInsight.text: If this attraction is on your list, riding before the closure window begins usually avoids the scramble. Check operating hours daily; last-minute schedule shifts are common ahead of refurbs.

topstories.title: Tropical Americas construction progress visible at Animal Kingdom
topstories.body: Crews continue adding thematic details to the new land, including a decorated column in the carousel queue. The main entrance archway now has more finalized theming elements in place.

parkioInsight.text: Construction zones tend to funnel foot traffic into narrower pathways, especially near DinoLand. Avoiding that corner of the park during peak afternoon hours often saves time and stress.

topstories.title: Disney Parks improving ride reliability and hourly capacity
topstories.body: Both Walt Disney World and Disneyland have been working to boost attraction efficiency, reduce unplanned downtime, and increase the number of guests each ride can handle per hour.

parkioInsight.text: Higher throughput often translates to faster-moving queues even when demand stays steady. Targeting popular rides mid-afternoon may yield better results than in past months.

topstories.title: New Music of EPCOT vinyl now available on streaming services
topstories.body: The two-LP set inspired by the 1983 Official Album of EPCOT Center can now be streamed online. The release celebrates the park's musical legacy with remastered and updated tracks.

parkioInsight.text: EPCOT nostalgia runs deep. Physical vinyl copies of limited releases tend to sell out quickly at park merchandise locations; stopping by Mouse Gear or Creations Shop early in the day may improve your odds.

topstories.title: El Capitan Theatre screens 4K restoration of Alice in Wonderland
topstories.body: The Hollywood venue is marking its centennial with a restored version of the 1951 animated classic. Special screenings run for a limited time.

parkioInsight.text: El Capitan screenings often include pre-show entertainment and organ music. Arriving 20–30 minutes early usually secures better seating and lets you catch the full experience.

topstories.title: Holiday Lilo & Stitch Loungefly mini backpacks now online
topstories.body: New seasonal designs featuring Stitch in Santa attire and other festive themes have launched on the Loungefly website. Retail price is $90 per backpack.

parkioInsight.text: Popular Loungefly drops tend to sell out within hours online and at park shops. If you want one, ordering now—or hitting World of Disney at rope drop—often beats the rush.

icymi.title: runDisney Wine & Dine 5K draws criticism over long character lines
icymi.body: Balloon ladies and extended waits for character meet-and-greets during the 2026 race sparked complaints on social media. Some runners felt the experience was poorly managed.

icymi.title: Disney releases 2026 holiday merchandise guide online
icymi.body: The official blog published a shopping guide for seasonal items, covering toys, apparel, and collectibles. Products are available at parks and shopDisney.

icymi.title: Neiman Marcus offers $180,000 Star Wars experience in holiday catalog
icymi.body: The luxury retailer's Fantasy Gifts collection includes an exclusive Lucasfilm tour tied to the 50th anniversary of A New Hope. The package retails for $182,500.

spotlight.title: New Magic Kingdom souvenirs and Advent calendars hit shelves this week
spotlight.body: Fresh merchandise dropped across the park, including holiday-themed Advent calendars and seasonal apparel. Some items are also available online, but limited stock may sell out quickly at physical stores.

parkioInsight.text: Flagship shops like Emporium tend to restock overnight, so mornings often offer the widest variety. Popular seasonal items usually disappear by mid-afternoon on weekends.
